roles: Both splits were exposed historically. They are development replays, not new independent confirmation.
candidate_selection: None. Evaluate all 36 fixed final checkpoints.
execution_modes: Each hx_full and hx_margin checkpoint executes once under full and once under margin channels. Other families execute their own ordinary mode.
contrasts: A versus each of margin-trained/margin-executed, ordinary_gate, GRU, SSM and complete-history MLP
inference: Descriptive fixed-candidate differences only. No significance test, independent-sample confidence claim, post-test best-family selection or seed selection.
grouping: Ten mandatory-A1 accepted orders per object. Emotion objects are historical recordings; binding objects are source pairs sharing underlying recordings. Neither 10 orders nor overlapping pairs are independent recording samples. Actor identities are retained for provenance only; no IID actor assumption.
raw_outputs: All per-sequence, per-prefix probabilities, labels, predictions, reset and restoration flags, source recording IDs, actor IDs and exact accepted orders
diagonal_reuse: A and D each execute once and can be reused by aggregate summaries or control comparisons. Reuse creates no new independent observation.
